title: Passage and Trail
author: Vesper Eastwick
blurb: Jonah Brightwater, a bush pilot flying medicine and rumors into the interior, has spent three years measuring life in miles rather than years. Then an old rival hires the crew for the one job that was sworn off long ago — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must cross the range ahead of the snows before the glacier calving season opens the route — briefly.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
